subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should OpenClaw land this narrow provenance-aware internal-handoff drop, fold it into the broader orphan-repair strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759, or wait for that broader PR to settle first?
rationale: Both PRs target the same stale queued/orphaned user-message bug but make different session-state choices, and the current branch lacks live proof for its exact drop/preserve behavior.

options.title: Require proof and coordinate semantics
options.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers decide whether the internal-handoff drop belongs alongside or inside the broader orphan-repair PR, with redacted embedded-agent proof before merge.

options.title: Close after broader PR lands
options.body: Treat the proof-positive broader repair as canonical only once it has landed or maintainers explicitly decide this drop rule is unnecessary.

options.title: Land this narrow fix first
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers accept the six-source drop scope and have equivalent runtime proof for the branch-specific behavior.

recommendation.title: Require proof and coordinate semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers decide whether the internal-handoff drop belongs alongside or inside the broader orphan-repair PR, with redacted embedded-agent proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced by PR 65478.
